messages:
maya: Quick sync — post-launch iteration planning. We have 3 customer escalations (two high-sev regressions, one data-parity edgecase) + 2 enhancement asks (embedding normalization and streaming fallback). Can we decide what goes into this micro-iteration (3 dev days) vs backlog? TL;DR: I can commit to 1 customer fix + 1 enhancement this sprint. thoughts?
chris: Can you paste the three ticket IDs and short repros? need to size.
olivia: Sure — tickets: RD-8792 (regression: tokenization mismatch with non-ascii -> breaks reranking), RD-8799 (latency spike when cache miss on long prefix), RD-8805 (embedding drift for customer X after model patch). Repro notes: RD-8799 shows 95p latency jump under specific sequence lengths (~4k tokens).
chris: RD-8792 looks like a tokenizer edgecase — likely <1d fix + tests. RD-8799 is tricky (cache config + batching) — estimate 3d to root cause and hard to guarantee in 3d. RD-8805 could be a model mismatch; might be mitigated by pinning model ver.
sam: QA: for RD-8792 I can add unit tests + a small fuzz harness — 1 day. For RD-8799 we need e2e performance runs and regression harnesses across seq length distribution — ~2-3 days. For RD-8805 I'd want a canary rollout with A/B evals on customer prompts — ~2 days to validate.
maya: Given sprint is only 3 dev days, proposal: prioritize RD-8792 (customer visible break) + embedding normalization (enhancement) as lower-risk shipping win. Defer RD-8799 full investigation to next cycle but add a mitigation (temporary cache-size tweak). OK?
chris: Agree on RD-8792. For embedding normalization (ENH-312) we can implement deterministic post-processing (normalize L2 + clamp) — 1.5d work including perf test. I can own both RD-8792 and ENH-312.
olivia: Customer X prefers the embedding fix but says tokenization break is blocking — they asked to push token fix first.
maya: Ownership: chris -> RD-8792 + ENH-312. sam -> QA for both. olivia -> customer comms + acceptance criteria. Deliverable dates: target code drop Fri EOD, canary Mon, full roll Tue. Metrics to watch: rerank failure rate, 99p latency, embedding cosine drift (we'll run eval against baseline).
sam: I'll add test matrix to GH PR and gate on the perf suite. plan: unit tests + staging canary.
chris: Quick note on rollback plan for RD-8792 — can revert tokenizer mapping in a single patch if anything odd, low blast radius. For ENH-312 we'll feature-flag it behind `embedding_normalize_v1`.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary build for branch chris/rd-8792 at 2028-06-01T09:00Z. :rocket:
maya: OK — sounds good. I'll update the roadmap ticket and move RD-8799 into "investigate" with tag "next-cycle/infra". Anyone object? :thumbsup:
chris: :+1:
sam: :+1:
